SELECT ts_doy, ts_t, wtmp_c, ROUND(wtmp_c * 9/5 + 32, 1) as wtmp_f
FROM pier
WHERE ts_t = (SELECT MAX(ts_t) FROM pier)
ORDER BY ts_t DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT 
  fished_date_doy,
  cls,
  COUNT(*) as trips_count,
  SUM(yt) as total_yt,
  SUM(anglers) as total_anglers,
  ROUND(SUM(yt)::float / SUM(anglers), 4) as yt_per_angler
FROM trips
WHERE fished_date_t >= (SELECT MAX(fished_date_t) FROM trips) - 7
GROUP BY fished_date_doy, cls
ORDER BY fished_date_doy DESC, cls
LIMIT 35
